summary: Nuvve Holding Corp. filed an 8-K on June 30, 2026, to report a reverse stock split at a 1-for-18 ratio effective July 6, 2026. The amendment reduces outstanding shares from ~9.44 million to ~524,652, with no change in authorized shares. No fractional shares will be issued; stockholders receive a whole share in lieu. The split proportionally adjusts convertible securities, warrants, options, and RSUs. This is a routine Nasdaq compliance measure, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal terms are involved. The event is administrative and does not constitute a restructuring, capital return, or other special situation.
